text: 据中证报，今日，A股大消费板块整体温和走强，酿酒、粮食等行业表现活跃，多只相关主题ETF表现突出。本周以来A股市场整体震荡回调，多只宽基ETF产品逆势“吸金”。其中，疫苗、创新药、医疗等细分行业表现强势，多只相关主题ETF今日涨幅超3%，领涨ETF市场。今日，受跨节资金拆借交易等因素影响，部分货币、债券类ETF产品成交金额显著放大。其中，短融ETF海富通成交额超700亿元，银华日利ETF成交额超300亿元。资金流动方面，资金在ETF市场上逢低吸纳宽基ETF产品。具体来看，截至9月29日，在本周以来资金净流入额排名前十的ETF中，有6只为股票ETF。其中，
text_en: According to China Securities Journal, today the A-share major consumer sector strengthened modestly overall, with brewing, grain, and other industries performing actively, and multiple related thematic ETFs standing out. Since the start of this week, the A-share market has been broadly fluctuating and pulling back, while multiple broad-based ETF products have attracted inflows against the trend. Among them, vaccine, innovative drug, medical, and other sub-sectors showed strong performance, with multiple related thematic ETFs rising more than 3% today, leading the ETF market. Today, affected by factors such as cross-holiday funding lending transactions, the turnover of some money market and bond ETF products increased significantly. Among them, the Short-Term Financing ETF Haitong recorded turnover exceeding RMB 70 billion, and the Yinua Rili ETF recorded turnover exceeding RMB 30 billion. In terms of fund flows, capital was bargain-hunting broad-based ETF products in the ETF market.
